newsitem.title: USA: American Intl to sell units for $20.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: American Intl to sell units for $20.4 mln.

text.p: American International Petroleum Corp said Thursday it had agreed in principle to sell its Columbian and Peruvian subsidiaries to Mercantile International Petroleum Inc for $20.4 million.
It said 43 percent of the $20.4 million would be in cash, the assumption of about $3.7 million in debt, and direct participation features.

The balance will be in new securities, including 4,300,000 common shares of Mercantile -- or about 10.2 percent the total outstanding -- and $3 million of Mercantile preferred shares, exchangable into one million common shares.
American International said the transaction is subject to certain approvals and to completion of due diligence by both sides.
It said it expects the transaction to close on or before February 10.
American International said it would use proceeds from the sale to repay debt and finish the expansion of its Lake Charles, La., refinery.
The company did not say how much debt it would repay. Company officials were not available to comment.
Mercantile International is based in Nassau, Bahamas.
